body.condition: There are constants \(0<c<C<\infty\) such that \(c\le p'/p\le C\) \(\nu\)-almost everywhere for every \(P'\in\mathcal V_P\).

novel.justification: This nonstandard bounded likelihood-ratio chart is directly verifiable on two regimes: a positive finite-support simplex restricted away from its boundary, including the displayed \(36\)-cell chart, and a genuinely nonfinite bounded exponential-tilt family \(p_\eta/p=\exp\{\eta^\top g-\psi(\eta)\}\) with bounded measurable \(g\) and \(\eta\) in a sufficiently small compact neighborhood. It deliberately excludes generic dominated DQM paths with uncontrolled likelihood ratios.
